entries.name: Associate Degree in Management
entries.reason: TEQSA's National Register lists this AIB course under "Courses previously accredited by TEQSA" with accreditation expired effective 16/03/2020. It has no live aib.edu.au page (404), no Wayback Machine snapshot ever, and is absent from AIB's current course-navigation footer and course list, which only covers its postgraduate MBA/Master of Management/GCM/GDM/GCRM/DBA/PhD suite. Confirmed discontinued, not fabricated-but-real.

entries.name: Master of Fine Arts (Design for Performance)
entries.reason: Absent from NIDA's current course-sitemap.xml (which lists all 3 currently live postgraduate MFA course pages: Cultural Leadership, Directing, Dramatic Writing) and from the postgraduate landing page's own course links; the guessed current-URL-scheme page (/study/postgraduate/mfa-design-for-performance/) 404s. On-site search confirms it was a genuine past award (alumni tagged 'Master of Fine Arts (Design for Performance)' as recently as a 2019 cohort in APDG Awards news coverage), so this is a real, historical qualification no longer offered, not an invented one. NIDA's current design training at CRICOS level is undergraduate-only (BFA Design for Performance).
